description: Full record for one place, by the place_id that num_search_places returned, including HOW TO BOOK IT on the venue's own terms. `booking.method` is one of: request (the venue takes requests through NUM and confirms each one itself), venue_system (send the traveller to booking.url, prefilled when you pass party_size, date and time), phone (the number is for the traveller to call), not_through_num, closed, unknown. Follow booking.guidance exactly. If open_status.closed is true, NUM holds evidence the place has gone: do not send anyone there. accolades carry their source; menu is the owner's own list and prices. Each call counts against the daily read quota.

date.description: Optional: YYYY-MM-DD, to prefill the venue's booking page.

party_size.description: Optional: people in the party, to prefill the venue's booking page.

time.description: Optional: HH:MM 24-hour, local to the venue.

name: num_get_place
title: Get place details and how to book it
